description:
Service Settings allow you to define the foundational configuration for repair operations in your automotive dealership. These include the default service categories (e.g., preventive maintenance, electrical, mechanical), labor rate tiers, warranty rules, and document naming conventions.

In ERPNext, this Doctype ensures that every repair job logged under General Repair follows a consistent structure. You can also define whether jobs require internal approval, customer sign-off, or job card validation prior to billing. These settings help enforce operational discipline and improve transparency across service processes.

Establishing this early helps streamline workflows, reduce repetitive setup tasks, and avoid errors during repair job creation. It also centralizes control for service pricing, turnaround time expectations, and compliance with manufacturer warranty policies.
